programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: The Lineup
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directed by Don Siegel. Stars Eli Wallach, Robert Keith & Richard Jaeckel. A ruthless hitman is sent to recover packages of drugs hidden inside the luggage of unsuspecting travellers.

programme.title: Panic in Year Zero
programme.desc: 1962. Sci-fi. Directed by & stars Ray Milland. Featuring Jean Hagan & Frankie Avalon. A family must fight to survive in the lawless aftermath of a nuclear disaster in Los Angeles.

programme.title: An Affair in Mind
programme.desc: 1988. Crime Drama. Directed by Colin Luke. Stars Amanda Donohoe, Stephen Dillane & Hilary Mason. A young novelist falls for a married woman, who then wants him to kill her husband.

programme.title: TPTV With Tyler Butterworth
programme.desc: In this exclusive interview Tyler celebrates the life and career of his parents, Peter Butterworth and Janet Brown, and shares tales of his own career from children's television to film and theatre.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: Frontier Journalism Was Fearless. 1955. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Carol Stone & Fay Roope. A brave journalist makes a stand when local gamblers attempt to force the mayor to get rid of Marshal Earp.

programme.title: The Terror (1938)
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Director: Richard Bird. Stars: Wilfrid Lawson, Richard Murdoch, Bernard Lee, Alastair Sims. No-one among the guests at Monk's Hall Priory suspects that The Terror is in their midst...

programme.title: The Stranger Came Home
programme.desc: 1954. Mystery. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Paulette Goddard & William Sylvester. A man returns home after being missing for three years to find those responsible for the attempt on his life.

programme.title: Look At Life Prison on Wheels
programme.desc: 1963. A Look into the trials and tribulations that confront drivers as parking is one of the major problems today in Britain's big cities.

programme.title: The Great Game
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars Diana Dors, Thora Hird & John Laurie. A wealthy chairman of Burnville United makes an unethical approach to a star player of another club.

programme.title: Brandy for the Parson
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. A young couple on a boating holiday off the Kent coast get caught up in a smuggling racket. Starring Kenneth More, Charles Hawtrey & Alfie Bass.

programme.title: Cromwell
programme.desc: 1970. Drama. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Richard Harris, Alec Guinness & Robert Morley. Politician and soldier, Oliver Cromwell, rises from the ranks to lead a civil war against King Charles I.

programme.title: The Story of Robin Hood
programme.desc: 1952. Action. Director: Ken Annakin. Stars Richard Todd, Joan Rice & James Hayter. When King Richard leaves England for the Holy Land, his subjects are left at the mercy of his cunning brother.

programme.title: Look At Life Coming, Sir!
programme.desc: 1964. A Look into the developing hotel industry and the problems that it has to face.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Accidental Death. 1963. Director: Geoffrey Nethercott. Stars John Carson, Jacqueline Ellis & Derrick Sherwin. The adopted daughter of Colonel Paxton and her boyfriend are surprised by an intruder.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: That Woman
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Richard Kinon. Stars Ida Lupino, Peter Leeds & Dorothy Neumann. A widow from the city, in denial her husband has died, moves to the farm of her brother in law's family.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Impractical Joker. 1966. Stars Adam West & Cesar Romero. The Joker vandalises a number of key objects around Gotham. Commissioner Gordon calls Batman and Robin to solve the enigmatic clues.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Extradition. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Phil Brown and Robert Shaw. Maguire must serve a warrant to an American gangster seeking sanctuary in England to ensure he is sent back to the US.

programme.title: The Bargee
programme.desc: 1964. Comedy. Directed by Duncan Wood. Stars Harry H. Corbett, Hugh Griffith & Ronnie Barker. The film charts the course of love of a Casanova who lives and works on the canals, breaking hearts.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
